title: Research plan
desc: Ten sections to fill in before you collect anything: question, mode, two methods, sample, instrument, procedure, analysis plan, consent, timeline, and expected limits.

title: Planning matrix
desc: One row per sub-question: the data you need, its source, the method, and the family. It counts your families and tells you if your plan uses at least two.

title: Method justification and checking sentence
desc: A sentence shape for justifying each method, three worked examples, the checking sentence for your pair, and a table for naming a method by what you actually did.

title: Invitation and consent script
desc: An invitation, a list of what to tell people, a consent form, a short survey version, and a check before you use it. It does not replace formal review.

title: Interview guide
desc: An opening script, core questions with probes, one question that could surprise you, a closing, and a check for each question.

title: Observation guide and field notes
desc: A setting sheet, prompts for what to watch, time-stamped notes with description and interpretation in separate columns, and a space sketch.

title: Codebook and second-coder check
desc: A codebook with definition, example, and exclusion for each code, plus a sheet that records a second coder's codes and counts the agreements.

title: Deviation log and recruitment log
desc: Record every change to your plan and every recruitment attempt. The sample sheet works out the gap between your target and what you collected.
